verdict.rationale: The pack shows ROS 2 code is publicly readable: there is a public GitHub repository (github.com/ros2/ros2), and the docs are served from public GitHub source repos. One community user also describes their team contributing ARM64 support, which suggests an open contribution model. No item names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the license (e.g. Apache 2.0) for the core repositories, license coverage across all packages, and independent corroboration of the license terms.
